text: The paper reports that in the Control setting the judge often assigns probabilities close to 0.5 to both answers, while the Combined strategy gives the largest gap between correct and incorrect answers in most rounds. The judge nearly always chooses to continue the debate, and its probabilities only become polarized in round 5, when it is reminded that no rounds remain.
title: LLM judge stays near 0.5 and keeps continuing debates until the final round
